title: Anchorage count-up figure
description: A figure such as "5+", "1.4B" or "$124,786.32" that counts up from a fraction of its value with a long ease-out the first time it scrolls into view, keeping its prefix, suffix, decimals and thousands commas. Its width is reserved, so nothing around it shifts.
notes: static HTML and reduced motion show the final value; the count runs only after hydration
style it from outside (size, gradient text): it renders plain inline text
